entities.name: Wilhelm Emmanuel Freiherr von Ketteler
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Baron Wilhelm Emmanuel von Ketteler was a German theologian and politician who served as Bishop of Mainz. His social teachings became influential during the papacy of Leo XIII and his encyclical Rerum novarum.
